_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil base rate (3% directional moves) and unresolved structural divergences make HOLD the only statistically honest call — a directional guess here is a claim to see a breaker that neither brain can credibly identify.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forces HOLD with high self-awareness of direction failure mode; narrative implies UP bias via mean-reversion framing. Split on direction.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive (>30) and stablecoin growth resumes (>55) with BTC holding above $62K
